title: Rebalance ZOOP starting energy
details: ZOOP starting energy (35.0) ниже чем PHOT (45.0), делая ZOOP сложнее. Выровнять или отбалансировать в config.py.
notes: Raised ZOO_INITIAL_ENERGY from 35.0 to 50.0 in config.py (was 65.0 originally, reduced to 35.0 which made ZOOP too weak vs PHOT=45.0). ZOOP predators now start with enough energy (50.0) to hunt before starving, given their 0.55x metabolism multiplier. No Cython rebuild needed (constant is Python-only in cell.py, not in sim_core.pyx). All tests passed.
